check_reversing_subarray_sorted: check if reversing a single contiguous subarray makes the first n elements of an array sorted
find_mismatch_boundaries: find the front and back indices where the array first and last diverge from its sorted version
verify_decreasing_subarray: verify that the subarray between mismatch boundaries is strictly decreasing and can be reversed to sort
run_f_gold_test_cases: run the f_gold function against a set of parameterized test cases and count successes
compare_f_filled_to_f_gold: compare the output of f_filled against f_gold across multiple test inputs and print results
